description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking a Palantir Platform Engineer to develop and integrate custom ETL workflows within the Palantir ecosystem. This role connects data conditioning capabilities with Palantir tooling to improve observability, accelerate processing, and provide visibility throughout the data transformation lifecycle.
You will use Palantir Foundry, PySpark, Python, and ontology modeling to build scalable data pipelines. Working with cross-functional teams, you will apply AI, data governance, and validation practices to deliver reliable data products for advanced analytics.

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Design, develop, and integrate ETL pipelines within Palantir Foundry.



 
 Connect custom ETL conditioners to Palantir tooling to streamline data preparation and transformation.



 
 Develop scalable data processing workflows using PySpark and Python.



 
 Apply ontology modeling to organize data, define relationships, and support downstream analysis.



 
 Implement logging and monitoring to provide visibility into pipeline performance and data transformation activities.



 
 Use AI to augment data pipelines and improve processing speed and efficiency.



 
 Apply data governance practices throughout ingestion, transformation, and delivery.



 
 Validate data products for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and readiness for analytical use.



 
 Prepare and integrate validated data products into advanced analytics tools.



 
 Apply DevOps practices to support deployment, maintenance, and reliable platform operations.



 
 Troubleshoot pipeline, integration, and data quality issues.



 
 Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to deliver actionable data capabilities.






Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 

 
 Experience working with Palantir Foundry.



 
 Strong understanding of ontology concepts and data ontology modeling.



 
 Expertise in building and integrating ETL pipelines.



 
 Proficiency in PySpark and Python.



 
 Experience implementing logging and monitoring solutions.



 
 Knowledge of data governance best practices.



 
 Familiarity with DevOps methodologies.



 
 Experience using AI to augment data pipelines.



 
 Strong experience validating data products.






Preferred Qualifications
 
 

 
 Experience connecting ETL conditioners to Palantir tooling.



 
 Experience improving observability and accelerating data conditioning workflows.



 
 Experience providing end-to-end visibility into data transformation processes.



 
 Familiarity with integrating validated data products into analytics tools for data exploitation.






 #CJ



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
